_meta.description: Per-endpoint p95 latency budgets enforced by tests/helpers/perfBudget.js

/api/webhook/alert.rationale: Plain webhook, no enrichment. 2x headroom over baseline 65ms for noisy CI.

/api/webhook/alert?useTradingViewData=tr.rationale: Single MCP call, bounded by TRADINGVIEW_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS=12000. 2.5x headroom over baseline 3200ms.

/api/webhook/expanded-analysis-alert.rationale: Per-symbol MCP cascade, bounded by EXPANDED_ANALYSIS_ALERT_TIMEOUT_MS=60000. 1.9x over baseline 48000ms.

/api/webhook/market-scanner-alert.rationale: Sequential scan, bounded by MARKET_SCANNER_TIMEOUT_MS=90000. 1.7x over baseline 72000ms.

/api/webhook/volume-confirmation.rationale: Single MCP call, no delivery. 2.4x over baseline 2100ms.

/api/webhook/symbol-analysis.rationale: Single MCP call, optional MTF. 2.3x over baseline 3500ms.

/api/jobs/tradingview-analysis.rationale: Validation only; work is async. 4.3x over baseline 70ms.

/api/alerts.rationale: Firestore list, admin read. 3.3x over baseline 240ms.

/api/alerts/export.rationale: Firestore bounded JSONL/CSV export. 2.2x over baseline 1600ms.

/api/alerts/:alertId.rationale: Single Firestore document fetch. 3.3x over baseline 90ms.

/api/status.rationale: Capability snapshot, dependency probes cached. 2.8x over baseline 180ms.

/api/scanner-presets.rationale: In-memory / Firestore preset list. 3.5x over baseline 230ms.

/api/trading/binance/orders.rationale: Operator order submission, bounded by BINANCE_TRADING_TIMEOUT_MS.
